description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function that compiles the 'default' modifier, which is used to assign a default value to variables if they are empty or unset. The function generates PHP code that evaluates whether a variable has a value, and if not, assigns a default.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_default
methods.description: Generates PHP code to assign default value if variable is empty or unset, supporting multiple default parameters.
